svg.aria-label: AV conduction: follow atrial and ventricular clocks separately

g.text: AV conduction: follow atrial and ventricular clocks separately
Each row: 6 s, 25 mm/s and 10 mm/mV. Orange dots mark P onset.
A: first-degree delay. Every P conducts; PR = 0.24 s.
B: Mobitz-I pattern. PR 0.16, 0.20, 0.24 s, then a nonconducted P.
C: Mobitz-II pattern. Conducted PR = 0.16 s; intermittent nonconduction.
D: complete AV block. P-P = 0.8 s; R-R = 1.5 s; independent timing.
A fixed 2:1 ratio alone does not establish Mobitz I or II. Always assess perfusion.
Original teaching schematic. Not a patient ECG or a diagnostic simulator.
